column1: # Modified by The Agent Factory for Claude Academy: rebranding and web language detection (see BRANDING.md).
# French (fr) interface catalog, written by The Agent Factory for Claude Academy (Canadian French).
# Same format and clean-room rules as zh-hans.tsv: context <TAB> English source <TAB> translation.
# English sources are UPSTREAM WordCraft strings; rebrand.py rewrites the renamed ones.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# computing vocabulary. No Microsoft Word (or other product) localisation was consulted or copied.
# Product, format and technology names (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP …) stay as they are.
